[KB:output.md].title: Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment for Louvicourt Tailings Storage Facility
[KB:output.md].author: Technical Report
[KB:output.md].description: PSHA report analyzing seismic hazard for the Louvicourt TSF site using CanadaSHM6 source model, NGA-East ground motion models, and site-specific conditions with Vs30 of 1,853 m/s. Includes hazard calculations for multiple return periods (1/2,475, 1/5,000, 1/10,000 years), disaggregation analysis, ground motion selection, and comparison with 2020 NBCC values.

sections: SLOT 1: Identify point sources for Louvicourt site in CanadaSHM6
SLOT 2: Determine maximum magnitude (Mmax) for source zone
SLOT 3: Determine PGA range for 1/10,000 year return period
SLOT 4: Compare PGA values with NBCC Canada
SLOT 6: Investigate PEER NGA spectral matching methodology
SLOT 7: Verify magnitude ranges for rare event selection
SLOT 8: Explain spectral matching drift at short periods
SLOT 9: Validate recommendation to relax magnitude constraints
